        "Fresh full two-file139-line patch read. The added manager test finds fourth@SOMETHING.invalid; the preexisting directory-level tests exercise a different API.",
        "Fixed accepted code trims and lowercases both the input and each cached email key. It still iterates directories/cards in reverse to preserve the first ordinary-order match, catches directory errors, and returns Map.get for missing nonempty input. Empty input returns null. Current tests explicitly build the manager cache in one case then query another, check whitespace and mixed-case second addresses, change a card, and check old/new addresses after invalidation. Source assertions were read, not executed.",
        "The unrelated local cleanup makes ensureUniquePrefName return a concrete uniquePrefName and both LDAP and JS/CardDAV callers assign prefName from that result. It adds precise URI diagnostics and narrow JSDoc types. The reviewer proposes Delete address book failed:; the actual landing uses Delete address book failed; uri=${uri}. This is an applied local diagnostic wording change, not a global error-format rule. Current header updateRecipient stores the found card and _updateAvatar uses card.photoURL; no avatar rendering was exercised."
      ],
